study: Fresh non-query-directed worlds after reviewer-triggered redesign
status_at_registration: planned before generating any study world or outcome
lambda_star_definition: max(r0,r1,1/r0,1/r1), r1=m_O/p_O and r0=(1-m_O)/(1-p_O), across cells; gamma=0 additional worlds use exact Lambda=1. Latent ratio is a separate diagnostic, not this boundary.

primary.worlds: 48 confounded worlds, equal weight across 12 size/design/drift strata
primary.endpoint: world-average paired difference in certification frequency: fusion_projected minus the indicator that either full-alpha standalone OBS or projected-moment source certifies; the baseline union is a comparison, not an authorized combined certificate
primary.hypothesis: The mean paired difference is at least 0.05 (five percentage points)
primary.interval: Primary decision uses a finite-sample one-sided 95% Hoeffding lower bound: mean minus sqrt(2*log(20)/48), because each independent-world paired rate lies in [-1,1]. A descriptive stratified t interval uses the unbiased within-stratum world variance and Welch-Satterthwaite df; it is labeled approximate and cannot trigger the confirmatory decision.
primary.decision: Regard the prespecified five-percentage-point target as supported only if the distribution-free lower endpoint exceeds 0.05. No additional p-value or optional stopping.

coverage: Whole confidence-set membership for every view including refused materializations; per-query lower-bound validity, false positive decisions and refusal separately. Do not treat queries or reused configurations as independent coverage trials.
secondary: All sizes, source budgets, sensitivity boundaries, nonzero drift boundaries, unconfounded Lambda=1, independent learned policies, alternative R interval construction, and within-world variability; descriptive, no confirmatory multiple-testing claims.
stopping_rule: All 60 independent worlds and five repetitions, both source budgets and radii, all three policies and five methods. No regeneration, positive-world filtering, or seed tuning.
compute: Existing project Python, CPU only, at most four workers with BLAS/native HiGHS one thread each; persistent log and source manifest.
